2	  {
3	    "comment_id": 4439288892,
4	    "path": "apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/reconcile/reconcile-dialog.tsx",
5	    "line": 213,
6	    "finding": "👮 **Wachiman** · 🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Dragging to select a file name now toggles the row (confidence medium)**\n\nThe row's `onClick` fires for any click whose target isn't the input. That includes the click Chromium sends after a drag-select when mousedown and mouseup both land inside the `<li>`. Someone who drags over `.rowNow` or `.rowAfter` to copy a long file name will untick (or re-tick) that row as a side effect. The change does show on screen (dimmed row, strikethrough, a different summary count and button label), but it's easy to miss after a copy. One fix is to skip the toggle when `window.getSelection()?.toString()` is non-empty. Another is to add `user-select: none` to `.rowSelectable`, if copying names isn't something users need.\n\n<!-- wachi:finding -->",
7	    "replies": [
8	      {
9	        "author": "csdev19",
10	        "body": "Real, fixed in 59f6d481: the row's click handler returns early when `window.getSelection()` has text, so a drag-select over a name to copy it no longer toggles the row. The test now selects text, clicks the row and checks the box keeps its state. Kept text selectable rather than `user-select: none`, because copying long file names is useful here."
11	      }
12	    ]
13	  }
14	]

contracts.action: Row click no longer toggles the finding when text is selected (window.getSelection() non-empty)
contracts.equivalent_path: The same row onClick handler (reconcile-dialog.tsx:211-219) and the checkbox's onChange (reconcile-dialog.tsx:230), both calling setFixing.
contracts.before_after: Before: any click on the row other than on the input toggled it, including the click that ends a drag-select. After: that click returns early when a selection exists. A plain click collapses any prior selection on mousedown, so toString() is empty and the toggle still runs. A double-click toggles once, because the second click sees the selected word.
contracts.visible_effect: Dragging over a file name to copy it leaves the row ticked or unticked as it was. A plain click still toggles the checkbox, dimming, count and button label.
contracts.failure_mode: No async call is involved. getSelection() can return null, which the optional chaining handles by falling through to the toggle.

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. The row's onClick at reconcile-dialog.tsx:216 now returns early when window.getSelection() has text, so a drag-select no longer toggles the row. The test at reconcile.test.tsx:368-374 mocks a selection, clicks the row and checks the box keeps its state.

input.summary: The selection guard in the row click handler fixes the earlier drag-select finding. The test covers it and I found nothing new to flag. A plain click clears any earlier selection, so ordinary toggling is unaffected.
